_doc: The Atlas Vault app manifest: a password manager, end-to-end encrypted, held to a stricter threat model than todo. Its kinds are namespaced `vault.<kind>`; on the wire (sync protocol 7, docs/decisions/0006) every one is `vault.sealed`, with opaque field tags and the real kind inside the encrypted value, and rows written before protocol 7 (under the real kind) stay readable until clients migrate them. Vault v1 is personal: the server never fans its ops out to another account and reads none of their fields, so every field value is encrypted (nothing public or plaintext), including the item type, its folder and its timestamps. `vault.item` is one item (login, note, card, identity, ssh_key, api_key: name, typed fields, urls, notes, tags, folder, favorite, secret field history), `vault.folder` one folder, `vault.preference` one of the app's settings. `api_tokens` is the policy for API tokens that include the app, which the server enforces: an expiry is required, at most `max_lifetime_days` after creation, a token is read-only unless its creator opts in to writes, and it is for the vault alone (`exclusive`: no other app's key travels with a vault secret). Bump `version` whenever the kinds, their plaintext fields or the token policy change.
name: Atlas Vault
